en.name: Dumbbell Curl
setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
execution: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward much.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Swinging the weights with the hips.

en.name: Barbell Curl
setup: Hold the bar with palms facing forward, hands shoulder width.
Stand tall with the bar against your thighs.
execution: Curl the bar up to chest height, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Leaning back to swing the bar up.

en.name: Triceps Pushdown
setup: Attach a straight or angled bar to a high pulley.
Grip it overhand and pin your elbows to your sides.
execution: Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise until your forearms pass parallel to the floor.
mistakes: Letting the elbows move forward and back.
Leaning over the bar to push with body weight.

en.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
setup: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Tuck your elbows at your sides.
execution: Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly until your forearms are just above parallel.
cues: Split the rope at the bottom

en.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
execution: Curl the dumbbells up while keeping the palms facing each other.
Lower slowly.

en.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
setup: Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar above your chest with a narrow grip.
Tilt your arms slightly back toward your head.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward the top of your head.
Extend your elbows to return the bar above your chest.
mistakes: Moving the upper arms as well as the forearms.
en.safety: Use a weight you control; a dropped bar lands on the face.

en.name: EZ-Bar Curl
setup: Grip the angled parts of an EZ bar with palms facing up.
Stand tall with the bar at your thighs.
execution: Curl the bar up while your elbows stay at your sides.
Lower it slowly.

en.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
setup: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Set your shoulder blades and unrack the bar.
execution: Lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows tucked close to your body.
Press until your arms are straight.
mistakes: Gripping so narrow that the wrists bend.
en.safety: Use a spotter or safety arms when you work close to failure.

en.name: Triceps Dip
setup: Grip the dip bars and press up to a support with straight arms.
Keep your torso upright and legs under you.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Leaning far forward, which shifts the work to the chest.
en.safety: Stop the descent where your shoulders stay comfortable.

en.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setup: Sit on an upright bench holding one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Cup the top plate of the dumbbell in your palms.
execution: Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

en.name: Preacher Curl
setup: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with palms up.
execution: Curl the bar up until your forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower it slowly until your arms are almost straight.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad.

en.name: Cable Curl
setup: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley.
Stand close and grip it with palms up.
execution: Curl the bar to your chest while the elbows stay at your sides.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
setup: Set a bench to about 45 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down behind your torso.
execution: Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms forward.
Lower slowly into the full stretch.
mistakes: Lifting the shoulders off the bench.

en.name: Concentration Curl
setup: Sit on a bench with your legs apart.
Hold a dumbbell and rest the back of your upper arm on your inner thigh.
execution: Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly to a straight arm.
mistakes: Lifting the elbow off the thigh.

en.name: Bench Dip
setup: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands next to your hips.
Slide your hips off the bench and walk your feet out.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower your hips until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
mistakes: Lowering too far and straining the front of the shoulder.
Letting the hips drift away from the bench.

en.name: Diamond Push-Up
setup: Place your hands close together under your chest so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond.
Step back into a straight plank.
execution: Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping the elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

en.name: Dumbbell Kickback
setup: Place one knee and hand on a bench and hold a dumbbell in the other hand.
Raise the upper arm so it is parallel to your torso.
execution: Straighten your elbow until your arm is fully extended behind you.
Bend it slowly back to 90 degrees.

en.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
setup: Attach a rope to a pulley at about head height or lower.
Face away from it holding the rope behind your head and step forward into a staggered stance.
execution: Extend your arms forward and up until they are straight.
Let your hands return slowly behind your head.

en.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
setup: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Let your wrists hang past your knees with a dumbbell in each hand.
execution: Curl your wrists up as far as possible.
Lower slowly, letting the dumbbells roll toward your fingers.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs.

en.name: Dead Hang
setup: Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing away, hands shoulder width.
Step off the box or lift your feet to hang.
execution: Hang with straight arms and relaxed shoulders.
Breathe steadily until your grip is close to failing.
cues: Relax the body, squeeze the bar

en.name: Rope Hammer Curl
setup: Attach a rope to a low pulley.
Hold the ends with palms facing each other.
execution: Curl the rope toward your shoulders, elbows still.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Spider Curl
setup: Set a bench to a steep incline and lie face down on it.
Let your arms hang straight down with a dumbbell in each hand.
execution: Curl the dumbbells up while your upper arms stay vertical.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.

en.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
setup: Place your hands under your shoulders.
Step back into a straight plank.
execution: Lower your chest while your elbows brush your sides.
Press back up.

en.name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Turn your palms to face each other.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Extend your elbows to lift them again.

en.name: EZ-Bar Reverse Curl
setup: Hold an EZ bar with palms facing down.
Stand tall with the bar at your thighs.
execution: Curl the bar up while keeping the wrists straight.
Lower it slowly.

en.name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
setup: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Let your hands hang past your knees with light dumbbells.
execution: Lift the backs of your hands as high as possible.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Using heavy weight and jerking it.

en.name: Machine-Assisted Dip
setup: Set the assistance weight; more weight makes it easier.
Kneel on the pad and grip the dip handles with straight arms.
execution: Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up.

en.name: Seated Dip Machine
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at your sides.
Sit tall and grip the handles.
execution: Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

en.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
setup: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
execution: Curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly, letting the bar roll to your fingers.
cues: Roll it down, curl it up

en.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
execution: Curl one dumbbell up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm.

en.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
setup: Sit at a preacher bench or kneel behind an incline bench.
Rest the back of one upper arm on the pad with a dumbbell in hand.
execution: Curl the dumbbell up.
Lower slowly to nearly straight.

en.name: Machine Biceps Curl
setup: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's pivot.
Rest your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles.
execution: Curl the handles up.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Band Biceps Curl
setup: Stand on the middle of a band with feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends with palms forward.
execution: Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
setup: Anchor a band high, such as over a door or bar.
Hold the ends with your elbows at your sides.
execution: Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

en.name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
setup: Stand on one end of a band in a staggered stance.
Hold the other end with both hands behind your head, elbows pointing up.
execution: Straighten your arms overhead.
Lower your hands slowly behind your head.

en.name: Band Hammer Curl
setup: Stand on the middle of a band.
Hold the ends with palms facing in.
execution: Curl your hands up, keeping the palms facing each other.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Band Reverse Curl
setup: Stand on the middle of a band.
Hold the ends with palms facing back.
execution: Curl your hands up with wrists straight.
Lower slowly.

en.name: Zottman Curl
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Turn your palms to face forward.
execution: Curl the dumbbells up with palms facing up.
At the top, turn the palms down.
Lower slowly with palms facing down, then turn them up again at the bottom.
cues: Up palms up, down palms down

en.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
setup: Set a pulley low and hold the cable without a handle or with a small handle.
Hinge forward and pin your upper arm by your side, elbow bent.
execution: Extend your elbow until the arm is straight behind you.
Return slowly.

en.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
setup: Set a pulley low and face away from it, holding the handle with one hand.
Step forward so your arm is pulled slightly behind your body.
execution: Curl the handle forward and up while the upper arm stays back.
Lower slowly into the stretch.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Biceps Curl
setup: Face the anchor and hold the handles with palms up and arms straight.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with a straight body.
execution: Curl your hands toward your forehead, pulling your body up.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

en.name: Suspension Trainer Triceps Extension
setup: Face away from the anchor holding the handles overhead with straight arms.
Lean forward with a straight body.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower your head between your hands.
Straighten your arms to push back up.

en.name: Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Pushdown
setup: Attach a single handle to a high pulley.
Hold it with your palm facing up and the elbow at your side.
execution: Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Return slowly.

en.name: One-Arm Dead Hang
setup: Hang from a bar with both hands.
Release one hand and keep the other shoulder engaged.
execution: Hold with one arm for the set time.
Switch arms.
en.safety: Build up from two-arm hangs to protect the shoulder and elbow.

en.name: Plate Pinch Hold
setup: Place two plates together with the smooth sides out.
Pinch them between your fingers and thumb in each hand.
execution: Stand tall and hold the plates for the set time.
Set them down before they slip.
mistakes: Letting the plates touch the leg.

en.name: Wrist Roller
setup: Hold a wrist roller at shoulder height with straight arms.
Hang a light plate from the rope.
execution: Turn the handle wrist over wrist to roll the rope up.
Reverse to lower it slowly.

en.name: EZ-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
setup: Sit on an upright bench holding an EZ bar overhead with a narrow grip.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
execution: Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

en.name: Ring Support Hold
setup: Set the rings at about hip height.
Grip them and jump up to straight arms with the rings beside your hips.
execution: Hold with locked elbows, shoulders pushed down and rings pressed into your sides.
Step down when the rings start to shake out of control.
mistakes: Letting the rings drift away from the body.
